prompt: A tall, slender wizard's spire - the TOWER is the entire subject, NOT a hill or mound. CRITICAL PROPORTIONS: a thin cylindrical tower exactly 4-5 blocks in diameter and AT LEAST 28 blocks tall - height must be roughly 6x the width, a dramatic stone needle stabbing into the sky. Do NOT build a wide rocky base, hill, or boulder pile; the tower rises straight from a tiny 6-7 block footprint at ground level. Spend almost the ENTIRE block budget on the tall shaft and its vertical detail, not on the ground. Up the slender shaft: glowing GLASS windows at irregular heights, two small PLANKS balconies on OAK_LOG brackets, crooked OAK_LOG beams banding the masonry. Near the top the shaft widens slightly into a small round observatory chamber ringed with GLASS windows, capped by a tall pointed BRICK (dark red) cone roof that ends in a single GLASS orb finial. PALETTE: STONE and COBBLE for the shaft (alternate for weathered texture), BRICK for the cone roof, GLASS only for windows and the orb, OAK_LOG/PLANKS for balconies and beams. Composition: one tall vertical needle dead-center facing the viewer (-Z), towering and narrow against the sky. Lonely, magical, imposing. Put the full solid-block budget into the TOWER itself.
